description: Main application class for the Malayalam Calendar and Astrology app, responsible for initializing crash reporting and setting up a custom global exception handler to catch unhandled exceptions and report them.

classes.name: MalayalamCalendarApp
classes.description: Custom Application class that initializes crash reporting and handles uncaught exceptions by reporting them and terminating the app if no activity is active.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Overrides Application.onCreate(), initializes crashReporter, and sets up exception handling.

methods.name: setupExceptionHandler
methods.description: Sets a default uncaught exception handler that reports exceptions to CrashReporter or delegates to the default handler.

methods.name: getRunningActivity
methods.description: Uses reflection to access internal Android classes to find the currently active (not paused) Activity.
